name: Cold-Pressed Juice
description: An uncoated kraft-brown paper carton with a rectangular base and a gable fold-top closure, typical of a cold-pressed juice package.
negativeConstraints: Never render any text, logo, wordmark, printing, or embossed lettering anywhere on the carton; never add a label or emblem; no props, hands, or presenter in frame; background stays a clean white or very light neutral studio backdrop with soft even lighting only. Exception: a mark, wordmark, or label that the brief's art direction explicitly names is deliberate and must be rendered exactly as directed — the text bans above apply only to invented marks the art direction never asked for.
preservationNotes: Keep the carton's rectangular body proportions, kraft-brown uncoated paper color and fiber texture, and gable fold-top crease geometry identical and consistent across all four angles.
